theorem_title: Size and dynamic multiplier sum of the 50-row YAH adjacent-edge certificate
natural_language_statement:
Let $C_e$ be the fixed labeled YAH adjacent-edge certificate, whose entries $(a,r)$ consist of a natural multiplier $a$ and a row $r$. A row is dynamic exactly when its rule is $D_f$ or $D_t$. Then

$$|C_e|=50\quad\text{and}\quad\sum_{(a,r)\in C_e\,:\,r\text{ dynamic}}a=144057.$$

The second number is the sum of multipliers on dynamic rows, not the number of such rows. This records the finite certificate data independently of its cancellation consequence.
